_comment: Per-person controls (docs/design/per-person-controls.md): the shared cases the desktop app (src/net/person_controls_tests.rs) and the website (scripts/tests/person-controls-web.test.js) both answer. `files`: what a file of `size` bytes from someone gets under their `controls` (`protected`: the protected setup is on), one of mine (Files in messages decides), accept, ask_always, ask_over (with `mb`, the limit it is over), never. `records`: a saved record as read back (anything missing or unknown is its default; the size is kept in 1..1024 when read through mb()).

files.name: up to 10 MB, a 1 MB file is taken
up to 10 MB, exactly 10 MB is taken
up to 10 MB, one byte over asks first
up to 10 MB under the protected setup: within the limit my setting decides
up to 10 MB under the protected setup: over it still asks
up to with no size saved uses 10 MB
up to 0 MB reads as 1 MB
up to past the range reads as 1024 MB
an unknown choice is my setting
the notifications level does not touch files

records.name: an empty record is the defaults
words from elsewhere read as the defaults
a size kept while another choice is picked does not make it chosen
